title: Arccraft City
body:
**Arccraft** is a city-management plugin I created because I found Towny to be complex and difficult to set up. This is my take on the "Towny" concept wich is designed to be much simpler and more efficient. Please note that the plugin is still in a very early stage, so I cannot yet promise a completely bug-free environment.

This plugin is under testing and development on my own server, If you want to test it before download visit my server: **mc.arccraft.org**

For Placeholders, Economy and permissons to work you need Placeholder API, Vault or any permisson plugin on the server.

# **City Management**
- **/c create <name>** - Is used to found a city and claims the current chunk the player is in.
- **/c claim** - Claims the chunk the player is in and can only be used beside a already claimed city chunk.
- **/c unclaim** - Unclaims the chunk the player is in if it's already claimed.
- **/c invite <username>** - Is used to invite players to the city.
- **/c info <city name>** - Shows info of the city.
- **/c setrank <username> MEMBER, INVITER, OFFICER** - Is used to set the rank of a player to the city.
- **/c delete <city name>** - Is used to delete a city.
- **/c setspawn** - Is used to set the city spawn and when used the players current position in the city becomes spawn.
- **/c spawn** - Teleports the player to set spawn.
- **/c prot** - Is used to set protection to all the city claimed chunks.

# **Player Management**
- **/c kick <username>** - Is used to kick a player from the city.
- **/c ban <username>** - Is used to ban players from the city.
- **/c leave <city name>** - Is used to leave a city.
- **/c join** - Is used to join a city.

# **Economy Management**
- **/c deposit <amount** - Is used to deposit currency into city bank.
- **/c withdraw <amount>** - Is used to withdraw currency from city bank.

# **Placeholders and Permissions**

Placeholders:
- **%city_name%** - Returns the first city the player is in.
- **%city_count%** - Returns how many cities they are in (out of 3).
- **%city_bank%** - Returns the bank balance of the player's first city.
- **%city_upkeep%** - Returns the computed upkeep for the player's first city.
- **%city_current%** - Returns the name of the city they are standing in.

Permissions:
- **arccraft.admin** - Overrides all the cities protection and can be used to kick, ban and delete cities.
